# Set up environment and load data 
```{r}
# Clean environment
rm( list = ls() )

# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(phytools)
library(ape)
library(treeio)
library(ggtree)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggnewscale)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(cartography)
library(khroma)

# Import tree
setwd("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Phylogenies/EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC_NL_TW")
Fasttree <- read.tree("FastTree_phylo.tre")
Fasttree_mid <- midpoint.root(Fasttree)


# Load metadata
serotypes <- read.delim("Serotypes.txt", header=T) |> mutate(GBS.SBG = ifelse(GBS.SBG=="", NA, GBS.SBG)) 
CCs <- read.csv("combined_results_with_cc.txt") |> dplyr::select(Sample, clonal_complex)
SCs <- read.csv("GBS_GWAS_db_core_clusters.csv") |> rename(Sample=Taxon, SC=Cluster)
STs <- read.delim("ST_results.txt") |>
  mutate(ST2 = str_remove(str_remove(ST,"\\*"),"\\?"))


# Load phenotypes
phenotypes <- read.table("phenotypes_filtered.txt", header=T)
phenotypes <- phenotypes |>
  rename(Sample =samples ) |> 
  mutate(Age_cat = ifelse(binary==0, "EOD", "LOD/VLOD"))

# Prep metadata for tree
typing_data <- left_join(left_join(left_join(left_join(serotypes, CCs ), SCs), phenotypes), (STs |> dplyr::select(Sample, ST, ST2)))
fewer5_SC <- which(table(typing_data$SC)<=10)
metadata_tree <- typing_data |>
  mutate(SC2= ifelse(SC %in% fewer5_SC, "other", SC))|>
  mutate(SC2= factor(SC2, level=c(1:14, "other")))|>
  mutate(Serotype2 = str_remove(str_remove(GBS.SBG,"\\*"),"\\?"))|>
  mutate(Serotype2 = ifelse(grepl("III-", Serotype2), "III", Serotype2))|>
  mutate(Serotype2 = factor(Serotype2, levels=c("Ia", "Ib","II", "III", "IV", "V","VI","VII","VIII", "IX")))|> 
  rename("label" = "Sample")|> 
  filter(label %in% Fasttree_mid$tip.label)

# Fix missing CCs
ref_ST_cc_df <- rbind(unique(metadata_tree|> filter(!grepl("\\*", ST), !grepl("\\?", ST)) |> dplyr::select(ST, clonal_complex)), 
                       data.frame(ST= c(1750, 2107, 137, 1809, 235, 482, 1946, 2106, 234),
                                  clonal_complex=c("cc17", "cc17", "cc17", "cc23", "cc1", "cc17", "cc17", "cc19", "cc23")))

# Load CDC and NL accessions
library(xlsx)
NL_metadata <- read.xlsx("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/0.Raw_data/Netherlands_Sanger_metadata.xlsx", 1) 
NL_accessions <- NL_metadata |> pull(ENA.lane.accession)
CDC_metadata <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Typing/EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC/phenotypes.txt", header=T) 
CDC_accessions <- CDC_metadata |> pull(samples)


# Join tree with metadata
metadata_tree_v0 <- unique(left_join(metadata_tree |> dplyr::select(-clonal_complex), ref_ST_cc_df |> rename(ST2=ST)) |> 
  mutate(clonal_complex = case_when(
    label == "SRR29440471" ~ "cc19",
    label == "SRR29458952" ~ "cc17",
    label == "SRR29459527" ~ "cc1",
    label == "SRR29476238" ~ "cc459",
    label == "SRR29480489" ~ "cc17",
    label == "SRR29489178" ~ "cc17",
    label == "SRR29489593" ~ "cc1",
    label == "SRR29489703" ~ "cc19",
    label == "SRR29506764" ~ "cc19",
    label == "SRR29506975" ~ "cc19",
    label == "SRR29508494" ~ "cc1",
    label == "SRR31502751" ~ "cc452",
    label == "SRR5063593" ~ "cc19",
    label == "ERR1659749" ~ "cc19",
    label == "SRR23753882" ~ "cc17",
    label == "SRR23754097" ~ "cc17",
    TRUE ~ clonal_complex # keep existing value for all others
  )) |> 
  mutate(clonal_complex = ifelse(ST2 %in% c(4,16,103, 130, 255, 929, 932, 1553, 1559,1580, 1606), "No_CC", clonal_complex))) |> 
  mutate(Country= ifelse(label %in% NL_accessions, "Netherlands", ifelse(label %in% CDC_accessions, "USA", "Taiwan")))


# Join metadata and tree 
Fasttree_mid_metadata <- full_join(keep.tip(Fasttree_mid, metadata_tree_v0$label), metadata_tree_v0 , by = 'label')
Fasttree_mid_Nsub <- Fasttree_mid
Fasttree_mid_Nsub$edge.length <- Fasttree_mid$edge.length*2231314
Fasttree_mid_Nsub_metadata <- full_join(keep.tip(Fasttree_mid_Nsub, metadata_tree_v0$label), metadata_tree_v0 , by = 'label')


# Prepare heatmap data for phylo
## Serotype
Metadata_Serotype = metadata_tree_v0 |> dplyr::select(Serotype2)
row.names(Metadata_Serotype) <-  metadata_tree_v0$label
colnames(Metadata_Serotype)= c("1")
## CC
Metadata_CC= metadata_tree_v0 |> dplyr::select(clonal_complex)
row.names(Metadata_CC) <-  metadata_tree_v0$label
colnames(Metadata_CC)= c("2")
## Age category
Metadata_Age_cat= metadata_tree_v0|> dplyr::select(Age_cat)
row.names(Metadata_Age_cat) <-  metadata_tree_v0$label
colnames(Metadata_Age_cat)= c("3")
## Country
Metadata_Country = metadata_tree_v0 |> dplyr::select(Country)
row.names(Metadata_Country) <-  metadata_tree_v0$label
colnames(Metadata_Country)= c("4")


# Prepare colors for phylo
SC_colors <- c("#dbdb8d", "#1f77b4", "#ff7f0e", "#2ca02c", "#d62728", "#9467bd","#8c564b", "#e377c2", "#7f7f7f", "#bcbd22", "#17becf", "#f7b6d2",  "#c5b0d5", "#c49c94", "black")
names(SC_colors) <- c(1:14, "other")
Serotype_colors <- c(color("muted")(9),"#D55E00" , "grey")
names(Serotype_colors) <- levels(Metadata_Serotype[,1])
CC_colors <- carto.pal(pal1 = "pastel.pal" ,n1 = 13)
names(CC_colors) <- c("cc1",   "cc12" , "cc17" , "cc19",  "cc22",  "cc23"  ,"cc26"  ,"cc283", "cc327", "cc452", "cc459" ,"No_CC")
Age_cat_colors <- c("#004488", "#DDAA33", "#BB5566")

# # Save clean version of data
# setwd("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Phylogenies/EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC")
# write.csv(metadata_tree_v0 |> 
#   dplyr::select(-GBS.SBG, -SC2, -ST)|>
#   rename(Serotype = Serotype2, 
#          ST = ST2), "Clean_Typing_data.csv", quote = F, row.names = F)
```

# Plot only tree with scale 
```{r}
# Scale: Number of substitutions 
Fasttre_full_sp_pscale_Nsub <- ggtree(Fasttree_mid_Nsub_metadata, ladderize = T, lwd=0.1) + 
  geom_tippoint(aes(color=as.factor(SC2)),size=1.5)+
  scale_colour_manual(name="SC", values=SC_colors)+ 
  geom_treescale(x=0, y=3000, width=2000, color='red', fontsize=6, linesize=2, offset=20)
Fasttre_full_sp_pscale_Nsub

# Scale: Rate of substitutions / Site
Fasttre_full_sp_pscale <- ggtree(Fasttree_mid_metadata, ladderize = T, lwd=0.1) + 
  geom_tippoint(aes(color=as.factor(SC2)),size=1.5)+
  scale_colour_manual(name="SC", values=SC_colors)+ 
  geom_treescale(x=0, y=3000, width=round(2000/2231314,5), color='red', fontsize=6, linesize=2, offset=20)
Fasttre_full_sp_pscale

```


# Plot Fasttree full aln tree (double precision)
```{r}
# SC tips
Fasttre_full_sp_p1 <- ggtree(Fasttree_mid_metadata, ladderize = T, lwd=0.1) + 
  geom_tippoint(aes(color=as.factor(SC2)),size=1.5)+
  scale_colour_manual(name="SC", values=SC_colors)

# Serotype
Fasttre_full_sp_p2 <- gheatmap(Fasttre_full_sp_p1 + new_scale_fill(), Metadata_Serotype ,  width=0.15, offset=0.0005, 
               font.size = 5, colnames_offset_y = -10, color=NA)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = Serotype_colors, name="1: Serotype")

# CCs
Fasttre_full_sp_p3 <- gheatmap(Fasttre_full_sp_p2 + new_scale_fill(), Metadata_CC,  width=0.15, offset=0.005,
               font.size = 5, colnames_offset_y = -10, color=NA)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = CC_colors, name="2: CC")

#  Age category
Fasttre_full_sp_p4 <- gheatmap(Fasttre_full_sp_p3 + new_scale_fill(), Metadata_Age_cat,  width=0.15, offset=0.01,
               font.size = 5, colnames_offset_y = -10, color=NA)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = Age_cat_colors, name="3: Age of Onset")

#  Country
Fasttre_full_sp_p5 <- gheatmap(Fasttre_full_sp_p4 + new_scale_fill(), Metadata_Country,  width=0.15, offset=0.015,
               font.size = 5, colnames_offset_y = -10, color=NA)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("orange", "red", "#1f77b4"), name="4: Country")


Fasttre_full_sp_p5
```

# Plot Fasttree by COUNTRY
## Prepare data
```{r}
# Subset metadata by country
metadata_tree_CDC <- metadata_tree_v0 |> filter(Country =="USA")
metadata_tree_NL <- metadata_tree_v0 |> filter(Country =="Netherlands")
metadata_tree_TW <- metadata_tree_v0 |> filter(Country =="Taiwan")

# Subset tree by country
Fasttree_mid_CDC <- keep.tip(Fasttree_mid, metadata_tree_CDC$label)
Fasttree_mid_NL<- keep.tip(Fasttree_mid, metadata_tree_NL$label)
Fasttree_mid_TW <- keep.tip(Fasttree_mid, metadata_tree_TW$label)

# Add tree metadata
Fasttree_mid_metadata_CDC <- full_join(Fasttree_mid_CDC, metadata_tree_CDC , by = 'label')
Fasttree_mid_metadata_NL<- full_join(Fasttree_mid_NL_flipped, metadata_tree_NL , by = 'label')
Fasttree_mid_metadata_TW <- full_join(Fasttree_mid_TW, metadata_tree_TW , by = 'label')
```

```{r}
# Load sig 
Sig_hits_NL <- read.delim("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Phylogenies/EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC_NL_TW/sig_hits_NL.txt", header=T) 
# Find columns with 'ERR' in their names
err_cols <- grep("ERR", names(Sig_hits_NL))

# For each such column, replace '1/1' with 1 and '0/0' with 0
for(col in err_cols) {
  Sig_hits_NL[[col]][grepl("1/1", Sig_hits_NL[[col]])] <- 1
  Sig_hits_NL[[col]][grepl("0/0", Sig_hits_NL[[col]])] <- 0
  # (optional) Convert column to numeric if only 1s and 0s should remain
  Sig_hits_NL[[col]] <- as.numeric(Sig_hits_NL[[col]])
}

Sig_hits_NL_t <- as.data.frame(t(Sig_hits_NL |> select(contains("ERR"))))

Sig_Unitig <- read.delim("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Phylogenies/EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC_NL_TW/Sig_unitigs.txt", sep=" ", header=F)|>
  select(-V2)
Sig_Unitig[] <- lapply(Sig_Unitig, function(x) gsub(":1", "", x)) 
order_unitigs <- c("ATCTTTTAAAATAGAAACTGTTATTTTTTGCA", "TTGTTGATCATTATGTCCTAGACCTAAAGCATGTCCTAA", "AATATTTCGTTTAACAAAAAAAATACTTTGCGAGGTCTCCATGCAGA", "AGCGACGTTTATGAATGCAGTTTCTAAAGGAAAAAAA", "TTTATGAATGCAGTTTCTAAAGGAAAAAAAACTATTGTGG", "TGTAGATATTGAAAGGTTACAAAATGTAGTCTATGAGGG", "TCGGTTCGAATGTGGGATAACACATTCGTCCAC", "GACGAATGTGTTATCCCACATTCGAACCGACCTGTT", "AAAAATGTTTGAATTAGGTAGTAATATTGACA", "TGATAATAGTGGAGAAATTTGTGATAATTTATCTCA", "AAATTATCACAAATTTCTCCACTATTATCAGTGGATCCATCAT", "TTTAGAAACTGCATTCATAAACGTCGCTGGGCCGCCATGTGTGAT" )
Sig_Unitig <- Sig_Unitig |>
  filter(V1 %in% order_unitigs) |>
  mutate(V1 = factor(V1, levels = order_unitigs)) |>
  arrange(V1)

Unitig_sig_t <- metadata_tree_v0 %>% select(label)
for(i in 1:nrow(Sig_Unitig)){
  present_samples <- as.vector(unlist(Sig_Unitig[i, -1]))
  new_var <- ifelse(Unitig_sig_t$label %in% present_samples, 1, 0)
  Unitig_sig_t[[paste0("Unitig_", i)]] <- new_var
}
row.names(Unitig_sig_t) <- Unitig_sig_t$label
Unitig_sig_t <- Unitig_sig_t[,-1]
round(colMeans(Unitig_sig_t %>% select(starts_with("Unitig_"))),3)

# Prepare heatmap data for phylo
unitig_cols <- grep("^Unitig_", colnames(Unitig_sig_t), value = TRUE)
metadata_unitig_list <- lapply(unitig_cols, function(u_col) {
  df <- Unitig_sig_t |> select(all_of(u_col))
  df[[u_col]] <- as.factor(df[[u_col]])      # convert column to factor
  row.names(df) <- row.names(Unitig_sig_t)   # set rownames
  colnames(df) <- u_col                     # ensure column name matches
  df
})

# Load Gene distribution across samples
gene_presence_absence <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pyseer Results/Nextflow_pipeline_EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC/15.1.Main_analysis/gene_presence_absence.Rtab", header=T)
gene_sig <- gene_presence_absence |> 
  filter(Gene %in% PanGWAS_FastTree_sig$variant)
gene_sig_Sum_prop <- gene_sig|>
  mutate(Sum = rowSums(across(2:ncol(gene_sig)), na.rm = TRUE),
         Proportion = round(Sum / (ncol(gene_sig)-1), 3))|>
  select(Gene, Sum, Proportion)
gene_sig_Sum_prop
gene_sig <- gene_sig |>
  mutate(across(2:1541, ~ ifelse(grepl("1", .), "present", "absent")))
gene_sig_t <- as.data.frame(t(gene_sig[,-1]))
colnames(gene_sig_t) <- gene_sig[[1]]

# Prepare heatmap data for phylo
## arnC
Metadata_arnC = gene_sig_t |> select(arnC)
Metadata_arnC$arnC <- as.factor(Metadata_arnC$arnC)
row.names(Metadata_arnC) <-  row.names(gene_sig_t)
colnames(Metadata_arnC)= c("arnC")
## group_1981
Metadata_group_1981 = gene_sig_t |> select(group_1981)
Metadata_group_1981$group_1981 <- as.factor(Metadata_group_1981$group_1981)
row.names(Metadata_group_1981) <-  row.names(gene_sig_t)
colnames(Metadata_group_1981)= c("group_1981")

# arnC
Fasttree_p22 <- gheatmap(Fasttree_p21 + new_scale_fill(), Metadata_arnC ,  width=0.05, offset=0.052, 
               font.size = 5, colnames_offset_x = -0.002, colnames_offset_y = -100, color=NA, colnames_angle = 60)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("white", "darkred"), name="Gene") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") 

# group_1981
Fasttree_p23 <- gheatmap(Fasttree_p22 + new_scale_fill(), Metadata_group_1981,  width=0.05, offset=0.054,
               font.size = 5, colnames_offset_x = -0.002, colnames_offset_y = -150, color=NA, colnames_angle = 60)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("white", "darkred"), name="group_1981")+
  theme(legend.position = "none") 

# legend plot:
Fasttree_PanGWAS_leg <- gheatmap(Fasttre_p1_noleg + new_scale_fill(), Metadata_group_1981,  width=0.05, offset=0.056,
               font.size = 5, colnames_offset_x = -0.002, colnames_offset_y = -150, color=NA, colnames_angle = 60)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("white", "darkred"), name="Gene")
```

## TW 
```{r}
# SC tips
Fasttree_TW_p1 <- ggtree(Fasttree_mid_metadata_TW, ladderize = T, lwd=0.1) + 
  geom_tippoint(aes(color=as.factor(SC2)),size=1.5)+
  scale_colour_manual(name="SC", values=SC_colors)+
  guides(color = guide_legend(ncol=3))

# rotate nodes as needed
ggtree(Fasttree_mid_metadata_TW) +
    geom_text2(aes(label = node), hjust = -0.3, size = 2)
Fasttree_TW_p1_flip <- flip(Fasttree_TW_p1, 265, 243)

# Serotype
Fasttree_TW_p2 <- gheatmap(Fasttree_TW_p1_flip + new_scale_fill(), Metadata_Serotype ,  width=0.15, offset=0.0005, 
               font.size = 5, colnames_offset_y = -10, color=NA)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = Serotype_colors, name="1: Serotype")+
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol=2))


# CCs
Fasttree_TW_p3 <- gheatmap(Fasttree_TW_p2 + new_scale_fill(), Metadata_CC,  width=0.15, offset=0.005,
               font.size = 5, colnames_offset_y = -10, color=NA)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = CC_colors, name="2: CC")+
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol=2))


#  Age category
Fasttree_TW_p4 <- gheatmap(Fasttree_TW_p3 + new_scale_fill(), Metadata_Age_cat,  width=0.15, offset=0.01,
               font.size = 5, colnames_offset_y = -10, color=NA)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = Age_cat_colors, name="3: Age of Onset")+
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol=2))


Fasttree_TW_p4

# save
ggsave("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Phylogenies/EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC_NL_TW/Phylo_TW.png", plot = Fasttree_TW_p4, width = 10, height = 10, dpi = 300, units = "in", bg = "white")
```
